sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dragon Demon Barion is one of the eight Demon Lords of Ishgria who rules over the land of Fal Nerga, as well as the biological father of Karl.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Before the timeline of the game, Barion saved a human woman who was held captive by the lion tribe after he killed the tribe's leader. With the help of the woman's ability, he managed to win many battles. It was at that time, another warrior from Elgaia joined his side, thanks to his wife's help. Shortly after he saved the woman, he married her and had a baby boy. Unfortunately, the daughter of the lion tribe's leader retaliated and his wife sacrificed herself to protect their son.

Years later, as the ruler of Fal Nerga, Barion prepares a ritual to move Karna Masta back to the land of the Gods. However, Summoner and the party arrive before he could begin the ritual. After Liomerg's loss, he battled Summoner, then lost. Afterwards, his son came and cornered him further by activating his demonic power. However, before they could talk, Mora arrived and took Barion's power, leaving him powerless.

After the Summoner defeated Mora in Demon Castle Estria, Karl asked the Summoner to reclaim Barion's power that left in Sealed Altar. After the decisive battle, they managed to reclaim Barion's power and said power went back into Barion in Fal Nerga.

While the Summoner explores the other worlds with his limited summoning arts, Karl is seen to question Barion about his mother, to which Barion only speaks of her name. However, Barion remains silent with Karl, leaving him with the assumption he still needs to grow stronger if he wants to know more about her.

Barion briefly appears in Raid Battle X6: Maw of Madness as a raid boss in Mission 6 - A Small Victory and Frontier Rift: Heaven's End as part of the Raug forces. It is unknown whether or not Barion has any connection to the Galardhon storyline, as he does not appear in any of its cutscenes.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: Barion is shown as a strict demon even to his own son, as he refuses to talk with him because he is "not strong enough."
